info.title: agent-computer control API
info.description: Development control API: static validation, revocable service credentials, independent runtime grants, authorized definition plans, atomic apply, durable coordination and bounded queued Computer start admission. Candidate preparation has a separate trusted local worker. Pod dispatch, Ready, OIDC and execution remain unsupported. Credential-bound logical ConnectionSession creation, current views, bounded heartbeats and close are implemented; OIDC/browser login, connection tokens, ViewerSession and lease consumers remain unsupported. Candidate modify leases now provide durable connection-owned acquisition, renewal, guarded one-time internal dispatch journaling and zero-dispatch release. Writer executors, watchdogs, physical fencing and control leases remain unsupported.

post.description: Requires Computer activate, Workspace read/modify, App app.use/activate, private profile app.use and corresponding credential scopes. Pins the immutable dependency graph, allocates a generation and Candidate ID and reserves capacity atomically. Returns Queued only. A committed Workspace input is pinned; missing input returns 409. Storage preparation runs through a separate trusted worker; this HTTP call dispatches no storage/Pod operation. Replays require current authorization and do not transfer the original credential binding.

delete.description: Idempotently close an own connection. No key or body is required. Revokes later connection use, without cancelling background work, stopping compute, or proving input/writers drained. A repeated close leaves revision and events unchanged. Closing atomically marks Held writer leases Draining; a trusted reconcile can release only a zero-dispatch epoch.

post.description: Requires runtime.connect/read/modify scopes, exact own Active connection and independent Computer/Workspace grants. Acquires modify ownership on the current Prepared Candidate, default/max 30 seconds; recommend renewal every 10 seconds. Held or Draining owners block takeover, including after expiry. A Released head can advance its epoch. Retrying a key after a later epoch fails; it never reacquires ownership. Does not start an executor or advertise Ready.

PlannedResource.description: Resolved before/after resource spec, stable ID and immutable dependency versions. Name and expectedRevision are metadata outside the spec. requires_drain is a reconciliation requirement; no runtime transition has occurred.

DefinitionPlan.description: Immutable caller-owned plan; at most 8 MiB serialized, valid for first apply for 15 minutes by database clock. Missing declarations never delete existing data. Returned principal/organization come from authentication, not client input.

DefinitionOperation.description: Current operation metadata and per-intent progress from one organization-locked snapshot. event_sequence is the publication event; watermark is the observation stream position. Apply creates Queued/Pending metadata. Trusted coordination APIs can advance it, but this release has no runtime backend worker; database fixtures do not certify runtime success.

IntentProgress.description: Durable coordination status. attempts is the monotonically increasing coordinator lease epoch, not runtime generation. dispatch_started means an external effect may have occurred; it is not proof of execution or process termination.

RuntimeAccess.description: Current caller grants intersected with this credential scopes. This is informational, not a reusable permit, lease, budget reservation or runtime readiness statement. No inheritance across permissions, resources or related objects.

expected_revision.description: Control revision, initially 1; distinct from definition revision and generation.

expected_spec_revision.description: Current Computer definition revision to pin.

StartReceipt.description: Immutable original admission receipt. A replay can still say Queued after cancellation; read current runtime state. It is not permission to dispatch an external effect.

input_revision.description: Pinned committed Workspace input version; absent only in legacy receipts.

input_manifest_digest.description: Pinned input manifest digest; absent only in legacy receipts.

ComputerRuntime.description: Current admission control state. This development implementation cannot report runtime Ready.

ConnectRequest.description: Logical connection only. Identity derives from the current service credential; it is permanently bound to that credential. Capabilities are requested Computer permissions, not resource grants or available backend features. Lifetime is capped by credential expiry.

ConnectionHeartbeat.description: Self-reported presence only; not verified user input, readiness, billing or an idle-stop signal. Does not extend the session or identity lifetime.

ConnectionSession.description: Current own-session view. Replays return this current view, not a cached authority snapshot. Non-Active sessions expose no capabilities. Closing or revoking never certifies that a writer or process stopped.

AcquireWriterLease.description: Current Prepared Candidate only. Session must belong to the exact credential and request connect/read/modify; current Computer connect/read/modify and Workspace read/modify grants are all required. Duration is capped by the session deadline.

WriterLeaseCommand.description: Exact current owner, Computer generation, ownership epoch and lease revision CAS.

RenewWriterLease.description: Renew a live Held lease. Never shortens the existing deadline or exceeds the session deadline. Exact retries do not extend it twice.

WriterLease.description: Current own-epoch control metadata, not an IO capability or stopped-process proof. Held becomes effectively Draining on expiry or authority loss. Released requires a durable no_dispatch proof; a recorded dispatch remains Draining until a future physical drain/fence adapter is implemented. Ready remains false.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one header. Scoped to authenticated organization, principal and operation. Reusing a key with changed input returns 409; retired receipts return 410. Retry unknown outcomes with the same key and input.
